mentions.name: fx
mentions.description: A web-based old-school graphics effects project built in modern TypeScript, centered on a realistic TV static effect. It blits a full 2560x1440 screen of random pixels at up to 90 FPS on the CPU, emulates wide-aspect TV pixels and larger grains for realism, adds a subtle toggleable CRT scan line effect, and supports pausing via click.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://fx.leftium.com (https://github.com/Leftium/fx)

Old-school graphics in modern TS.

Several years ago, it was not possible to blit an entire screen of random pixels to the screen at a decent frame rate without something like shaders.
